integrity: The proof derives the exact pushforward measure for paired autocovariances, inverts that pushforward with a measurable sign-splitting parameter, proves the compatibility and uniqueness criteria, and realizes the finite-support counterexample with products of two-state reversible kernels. Exact-rational computation replays the formulas but does not replace the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The inverse classification is stated at the spectral-measure level; arbitrary continuous fiber points are not claimed to have finite-state realizations.
The paired sequence continues to determine asymptotic variance when its defining series converges; the information loss concerns individual autocovariances and finite-horizon quantities.

title: Exact information loss of paired autocovariances in reversible chains
